mapper.select: SELECT A.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id, A.request_control_command_id, A.sequence_act_type, A.digital_twin_id, A.digital_object_id, A.digital_control_Id, A.start_interval, A.control_command, A.next_sequence_identifier, A.next_sequence_condition, A.logical_expression, A.next_interval, A.condition_param, A.sequence_status, A.seqeunce_status_change_time, A.sequence_identifier, A.federated_twin_id, A.federated_digital_object_id, B.task_processing_id, B.task_processing_status FROM msa_control_command_sequence_info A inner join msa_task_processing_info B on B.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id = A.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id AND B.request_control_command_id = A.request_control_command_id WHERE A.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id = #{ctrlCmdSequenceId} and B.task_processing_id = #{taskProcessingId}
